claims.assertion: Swaruu says physical DNA is a limited projection of a higher-plane adma pattern; misalignment with consciousness can cause biological problems.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She claims laboratory genetic alterations in complex species fail within one or two generations, reverting or dying without viable descendants; plants differ.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu describes a 5D genetic map with 12 DNA helices and chromosomes, versus the 3D human representation's two helices and 22–23 chromosomes.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says human consciousness has experienced twelve or more alien species, whose memories are carried in DNA.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
